hints.title: Substrings Numeric Values
hints.text: Extract all substrings from the digit string and parse them into integers.

hints.title: Primality Filtering
hints.text: Test each distinct integer for primality using trial division up to its square root.

hints.title: Top-Three Summation
hints.text: Deduplicate identified primes, sort them descendingly, and sum up to the 3 largest elements.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: length of input string s (<= 10)
complexity.notes: Small string length yields at most 55 substrings.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Ignoring deduplication counts identical prime values multiple times.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set deduplication guarantees unique prime contribution.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle edge cases with no primes or fewer than three primes.
